usage: acme deploy [-h] [-e {dev,staging,prod}] [-f] [--timeout TIMEOUT] target

positional arguments:
  target                service to deploy

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -e {dev,staging,prod}, --env {dev,staging,prod}
                        target environment
  -f, --force           skip the confirmation prompt
  --timeout TIMEOUT     seconds to wait (default: 30)
